description: For a drop's creator: claim the proceeds its creator vault holds (the creator's share of trade fees, and the graduation payout). A royalty partner, if the drop has one, is paid their share in the same transaction. Fails early when nothing has accrued. Requires a signer: COOKIE_PRIVATE_KEY locally, or in external-signer mode this returns `needs_signature` for the user's wallet to sign (see submit_signed_tx).

collection.description: the drop's collection mint (or any of its items' mints)
